words.sense: Divide people into sharply opposed groups with little middle ground
misconceptions: Any political issue has polarized people
Public attention is the same as either process

words.sense: Turn a previously nonpolitical issue into a subject of political argument or competition
misconceptions: Public attention is the same as either process

semantic_axes.description: Whether the scene turns on division intensity.
Whether the scene turns on political framing.

edges.boundary_rule: Polarize means create sharply hostile camps; politicize means bring an issue into politics, even if views remain varied.

misconceptions.M1: Any political issue has polarized people
misconceptions.M3: Public attention is the same as either process
